method: Per-bin embedded source path sets (OpString/OpSource). include_closures (main->its include set) are Observation. direct_include_edges are the minimal DAG consistent with all cross-bin ordering observations (Inference): a file G is a direct include of F when G is in F's closure and G is not a majority-order descendant of another file in that closure. Sibling-vs-descendant is ambiguous from preorder, so some real direct edges may be under-reported.
ambiguity_note: direct_include_edges is the minimal DAG consistent with all cross-bin orderings; sibling-vs-descendant is ambiguous from DFS preorder, so a shared early include like inc/tracked_buffer.hlsl can appear to directly include unrelated later files (e.g. wall/inc/brick_vert.hlsl, grass.raster.hlsl) that are actually direct includes of the hosting main. For confident nesting use the shared-layer chain common->samplers->debug_utils->tracked_buffer plus include_closures (Observation).

raw_path_styles.note: `eval/../`-style raw embedded strings are kept verbatim in include_closures and in per-shader-mapping raw_path_variants; the skeleton tree uses the resolved path (no literal `..` dirs).
